asked: # Build: hotfix-build-manager (Current profile) - URGENT small fix ## What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 4 2026, voice) "Can you check build manager to see what's going? It says 21 things are going." ... "When I click them, they don't open up, and the steps in the build menu don't work." Book to a free named agent (Janitor Joey, else Ping Paulie). Register id `hotfix-build-manager` in the `current` profile + banner entry + What Brett said block. ## Bugs (live on main after last night's landings: #269 builds-one-page is NOT merged; #282, #283, #273, #275 etc. are) 1. **Clicking a build row in the Build manager / Builds page does nothing** - it must open the build's detail (steps, brief, What Brett said, PR, log). Find the regression (likely from tonight's landings: #282 build-prompt-origin, #283 home-cards, #273 crew-live, #268 menu-fit, #298 not merged) and fix at root. Check console logs for errors on click. 2. **Step actions in the build menu don't work** (tick/untick step, open step, context menu on steps). Fix. 3. **Stale statuses / wrong count**: the banner counts 21 'going' but only land-round-2 is actually running. Reconcile the builds store with reality: a build is 'running' only if its tmux session / headless process is alive (agent-slots status). Mark: paused (worktree saved, no process): plugin-lazy-load, browser-automation, profile-switcher-widget, app-style-override, terminal-tabs-left, git-status-board, main-area-tabs, molly-banners, molly-nav-submenus, terminal-drag-chain-tree, gizmo-companion -> 'paused' (or 'built, awaiting merge' if their PR is up and complete); urgent-main-ci-green (#284 merged) -> complete; anything whose PR is merged -> complete. Add a reconciler rule (zero tokens, in the existing every-10-minutes sync) so this can't drift again, and make the banner count = actually running. - Small and focused. Type-check + the builds/Build manager tests. One phone screenshot filed to UI Review (non-blocking). PR, merge as soon as CI is green, redeploy the console. Don't leave tsc/vite/playwright running. Report `_claude/builds/reports/hotfix-build-manager.md`. Commits clean and professional. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches (Brett, Nov 3 2026): a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. An UPGRADE (e.g. Opus → Fable) needs Brett's approval: when you reach one, run `node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs request-upgrade <id> <phase>`, ask once, and stop. Never approve a model switch upgrade yourself (no `act approve` on an upgrade), never relaunch on a higher model.

steps.text: Builds page: tap a row opens it; ticks no longer reverted by stale polls

result.summary: Builds page rows open on tap; step ticks stick (stale-poll race fixed); orchestrator steps open on tap; changes banner counts only live sessions; reconciler pauses builds no live process runs (7 merged -> complete, 9 idle -> paused). PR #309 merged, console redeployed.
